description: This file contains a Python implementation for managing a local etcd server, including starting, stopping, and client interaction, primarily used for testing or single-node setups within a distributed training environment.

classes.name: EtcdServer
classes.description: A class to manage a local standalone etcd server, including starting, stopping, and client access, with fallback mechanisms for binary location.

methods.name: find_free_port
methods.description: Finds and reserves a free network port by creating a temporary socket bound to it.

methods.name: stop_etcd
methods.description: Stops the etcd subprocess if running and optionally deletes its data directory.

methods.name: EtcdServer.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the EtcdServer instance, setting binary path, data directory, and internal state.

methods.name: EtcdServer._get_etcd_server_process
methods.description: Returns the current etcd subprocess if it exists, raises error if not started.

methods.name: EtcdServer.get_port
methods.description: Returns the port number on which the etcd server is running.

methods.name: EtcdServer.get_host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the etcd server.

methods.name: EtcdServer.get_endpoint
methods.description: Returns the server endpoint in 'host:port' format.

methods.name: EtcdServer.start
methods.description: Starts the etcd server, with retries and timeout handling, and registers cleanup on exit.

methods.name: EtcdServer._start
methods.description: Internal method to initiate the etcd server process with assigned ports.

methods.name: EtcdServer.get_client
methods.description: Returns an etcd client object connected to the server.

methods.name: EtcdServer._wait_for_ready
methods.description: Waits until the etcd server is ready to accept requests or times out.

methods.name: EtcdServer.stop
methods.description: Stops the etcd server and cleans up resources.
